Cape cross country captures conference crowns

School wins four Henlopen championships in a single week
By Dave Frederick • November 8, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
0:00 / 0:00 Instaread
Sponsored by

Cape sports history added a distinctive chapter Nov. 7 at the Henlopen Conference Cross Country Championship at Killens Pond State Park.

The boys and girls each won conference championships, joining field hockey and soccer to give Cape four conference crowns in a single week.

Both cross country teams did it the hard and unusual way.

The boys totaled 33 points to runner-up Sussex Academy's 72, and the girls scored 41 to Sussex Academy's 79.

Sussex Academy's Ben Moody won the boys' race; Owen Barron led Cape in third, with all five Cape scorers in the top 12.

Coach Matt Lindell said the state meet will hinge on his No. 4 and 5 runners.

With Shiloh O Grady out, Allison Ortiz-Rivera placed 15th, a run Lindell ranked among the finest he has seen in nearly 25 years.

Caesar Rodney's Morgan Thompson won the girls' race; Claudia Stazzone placed third for Cape.

The DIAA meet is Nov. 14 at Killens Pond, with Salesianum and Padua the top rivals.
